cite.quote: Display says empty while four of us sat still in a workshop.
Counts drift when two people pass the door together.
Hot afternoons show ghost occupants near the window.

tests.label: inference

threshold.value: At least 99% of occupied minutes detected and at least 95% of sampled counts within one person.

tests.value: Compare sensor logs to time-stamped manual occupancy and headcounts in real rooms. Include quiet seated work, paired doorway crossings, sunny rooms and back-to-back meetings.

cite.quote: The lights went off while I was sitting alone reading for half an hour.
CO2 lags by ten minutes, so the room shows empty after people walk in.

tests.label: inference

threshold.value: Zero releases of occupied rooms and zero false lights-off events across 100 scripted scenarios; lights on within 2 seconds of entry; at least 95% of scripted no-shows released within 10 minutes.

tests.value: Start booking in shadow mode; compare proposed releases with manual logs and test lighting on arrival, still occupancy, departure and outages. Compare against manual check-in and existing lighting controls.

cite.quote: Our electrician took two days for one floor.
the cabling cost more than the sensors.

tests.label: inference

threshold.value: At most two technician-hours per room on the standard retrofit path; itemized three-year cost for every pilot option.

tests.value: Trial retrofits in rooms with and without existing power or network drops. Log labor, materials, downtime, rework and obtain an itemized EU quote including subscriptions and maintenance.

cite.quote: 7 years at 1 report per 10 minutes; 14 months at 1 report per minute (typical office setting)
Battery swap schedule is a constant chore for facilities.

tests.label: inference

threshold.value: At least 24 months projected service life at the tested cadence, with assumptions documented.

tests.value: Measure battery draw at the reporting cadence that passes workflow tests; model replacement labor and validate the estimate with field telemetry.

cite.quote: Works council asked us to prove it does not see through walls.
Our works council wanted written proof that no image leaves the sensor.

tests.label: inference

threshold.value: No images transmitted, zero adjacent-room detections in 30 scripted trials, and documented retention and access controls approved before live use.

tests.value: Run privacy review as a gate before live deployment. Verify sensor outputs and retention, verify what leaves the device, and test for detections from adjacent rooms.
